nodes.name: Raise: Abomination
nodes.description: Raise an Abomination to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force.It is surrounded by a disease cloud, dealing 9 + 25% SP Nature damage to enemies when they deal damage and reducing their attack speed by -20% for 15 seconds.Command: Instantly unleashes an empowered disease cloud around it.

nodes.name: Fetid Ward
nodes.description: Activate a Fetid Ward on yourself and your Undead minions for 30 minutes.While active, 30% of your damage dealt heals you and your minions, split evenly amongst them, and healing received is increased by 10%.

nodes.name: Glacial Tap
nodes.description: Tap into necrotic energies, instantly regenerating 30 Runic Power.

nodes.name: Command: Hook
nodes.description: Command your Abominations to hook an enemy to their location, slowing their movement speed to a halt for 2 seconds.

nodes.name: Hulking Hordes
nodes.description: Increases your maximum health and the maximum health of your summons by 5%.

nodes.name: Lich Essence
nodes.description: Reduces the cast time of Lichfrost by -15% and reduces your spell pushback suffered from taking damage by 50%.

nodes.name: Icecrown Scriptures
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow and Frost damage dealt against Humanoids and Undead by 4%.

nodes.name: Vampiric Aura
nodes.description: While you are below 50% health, your Undead minions now heal you for 10% of their damage dealt.

nodes.name: Living Dead
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of Lichfrost and Crypt Swarm by -10%. Blight now refunds 25% of its base mana cost if it lasts the full duration.

nodes.name: Create Frozen Reliquary
nodes.description: Create 1 Frozen Reliquary that restores 30% of your missing mana.Allies may only use a Frozen Reliquary once per minute.

nodes.name: Life For Power
nodes.description: You absorb 20% of healing taken and gain a shield for the amount absorbed, lasting 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Bone Tithe
nodes.description: Siphon life from your undead minions, sacrificing 40% of their health to grant yourself an absorb shield equal to half of the health stolen for 20 seconds.Usable while stunned.

nodes.name: Ner'zhul's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Runic Power by 20%.

nodes.name: Phylactery
nodes.description: Create a Phylactery near you for 2 minutes.Upon taking damage which would bring you below 10% health, become a Shade, protecting you from all physical attacks and spells, but during that time you cannot attack or cast spells.Reaching your Phylactery in this state revives you with 40% of your maximum health. If you do not reach it in time you will die.

nodes.name: Tears of Lordaeron
nodes.description: Direct critical strikes regenerate 3% of your maximum mana and 9% of your maximum runic power. Periodic critical strikes regenerate 1% of your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Force
nodes.description: Damage dealt by your Undead minions now has a 5% chance to restore 2 Runic Power and 2% of your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Death's Due
nodes.description: Force a target to accept the reality of death, removing any invulnerability or immunity effects from them and cursing them for 5 seconds.If the target's health is below 20% at the end of duration, they take 800 + 200% SP Shadowfrost Damage.

nodes.name: Gravedigger
nodes.description: Reduces the cast time of Sacrifice Undead by -0.5 sec.

nodes.name: Reclaimed Life
nodes.description: Reduces the cast time of your Raise spells by -15%.

nodes.name: Mass Grave
nodes.description: Transform up to 5 nearby enemies into a ghoul, fearing them for 40 seconds (8). Only affects Humanoids.While above 50 Runic Power this spell is instant cast.

nodes.name: Disciple of Kel'thuzad
nodes.description: Increases your spell haste by 4%.

nodes.name: Improved Mandates
nodes.description: Increases the effectiveness of your Mandates by 20%.

nodes.name: Game of Bones
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Champion spells by -60 sec.

nodes.name: Corpse Commander
nodes.description: Reduces the Runic Power cost of Corpse Explosion by -20.

nodes.name: Lich Commander
nodes.description: Reduces the Runic Power cost of your Command spells by -5.

nodes.name: Dead Man Walking
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of root and slow effects against you by -25%.

nodes.name: Naxxramas Prodigy
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow and Frost resistances by 0.5 per level.

nodes.name: Cobalt-Plated Armor
nodes.description: Increases the Armor of your Undead minions by 300, scaling with your level.

nodes.name: Putrid Summoner
nodes.description: Each Undead Stance now provides an additional bonus:Undead: Assault: Increases your critical strike chance against Humanoids by 5%.Undead: Protect: Reduces your threat generated by -75%.Undead: Pacify: Reduces your damage taken by -10%.

nodes.name: Deadly Defense
nodes.description: Each of your summons now reduces your damage taken by 1%, up to a maximum of 10%.

nodes.name: Winds of Northrend
nodes.description: Increases the amount slowed by Lichfrost by -15%.

nodes.name: Raise: Decaying Colossus
nodes.description: Raise a Decaying Colossus to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force. While active, 25% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by the Decaying Colossus.Command: Unleash a powerful attack dealing Weapon Damage plus 100 to all enemies in front of it.

nodes.name: Foul Invocation
nodes.description: Transform into an undead monstrosity for 20 seconds, increasing your maximum health by 30%.While transformed you are immune to Fear, Sleep, Charm, and Disease effects.

nodes.name: Frost Runes
nodes.description: Dealing Magic damage now has a 15% chance to increase your haste by 10% for 12 seconds.

nodes.name: Command: Blight
nodes.description: Command your Decaying Colossus to blight the ground in a 10 yd radius beneath it, reducing healing received by -60% for enemies inside for 20 seconds.

nodes.name: Study of Death
nodes.description: When you cast Unholy Frenzy you now summon 3 Greater Zombies to aid you in combat for 14 seconds.Damage dealt by your Undead minions now reduces the cooldown of Unholy Frenzy by -0.5 sec.

nodes.name: Raise: Banshee
nodes.description: Raise a Banshee to aid you in combat, occupying 2 Life Force.It will channel on your target, dealing damage and draining their mana over time.Command: Drains 20% of your target's mana (up to a maximum of 40% of their own maximum mana) and deals Frost damage equal to the mana drained.

nodes.name: Animate: Frost Wyrm
nodes.description: Animate a Frost Wyrm that flies behind the Necromancer that blasts nearby enemies every 2 sec for 30 seconds, dealing 1500 + 14.88% frost SP + 14.88% Intellect Frost damage.

nodes.name: Flesh to Worms
nodes.description: Disease an enemy, dealing 15 + 11.06% shadow SP Plague damage and generating Runic Power every 3 sec for 18 seconds.

nodes.name: Crypt Plague
nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveDamage dealt by Crypt Swarm now applies 1 stack of Crypt Plague and Lichfrost applies 2 stacks.Crypt Plague (Damage)Deals 2 + 6% SP Plague Damage every 2 sec for 10 seconds, stacking 10 times.Additional applications do not refresh duration.

nodes.name: Cycle of Death
nodes.description: Increases your spell haste by 5%.

nodes.name: Master of Death
nodes.description: Casting Command spells on an enemy now applies Crypt Plague.

nodes.name: Rotting Flesh
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Flesh to Worms by 25% and allows its periodic damage to scale with your spell haste.

nodes.name: Swarmer
nodes.description: Increases the Runic Power generated by Crypt Swarm by 2 per tick.

nodes.name: Damnation
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow damage by 5%, doubled against enemies below 35% health.

nodes.name: Plague Science
nodes.description: Level 20 PassiveYour diseases and Crypt Swarm now deal 100% increased damage to enemies below 20% health.

nodes.name: Plague of Undeath
nodes.description: Disease an enemy dealing 32 + 25% shadow SP Plague damage every 3 sec and reduces the targets Holy healing received by -40% for 20 seconds.If Plague of Undeath is dispelled, the enemy takes 456 + 125% shadow SP Plague damage and is stunned for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Creeping Crypt
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Flesh to Worms by 25% against enemies below 35% maximum health.

nodes.name: Dark Harvester
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike and hit chance by 3%.

nodes.name: Expunge

nodes.description: Reinvigorate your diseases, refreshing all diseases on the target enemy and copying them, preserving their power and duration.You may use this abilty again within 10 sec to Infest another target, applying the copied diseases.

nodes.name: Necrosis
nodes.description: Increases the duration of your diseases by 25%.

nodes.name: Touch of Death
nodes.description: Allows Expunge to stack an additional time and increases the range of your Death spells by 20%.

nodes.name: Crypt Explosion
nodes.description: Casting Command spells on an enemy now applies Crypt Plague to 3 enemies near the primary target.

nodes.name: Creeping Plagues
nodes.description: You may now Infest an additional target after using Virulency.

nodes.name: Pandemic
nodes.description: Damage dealt by your Undead minions now reduces the cooldown of Virulency by -1 sec.

nodes.name: Festering Decay
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of Command spells by -15% and causes them to increase the target's spell damage taken by 10% for 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Unholy Runes
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Crypt Swarm by 15%.

nodes.name: Expediting Death
nodes.description: Each stack of Expunge now increases the target's damage taken from your Plague of Undeath by an additional 5%.

nodes.name: Mutation
nodes.description: For the next 15 seconds your diseases mutate causing them to act with accelerated lethality, allowing your freshly applied diseases to tick -50% faster.

nodes.name: Plague Revenant
nodes.description: Critical strikes now apply a stack of Crypt Plague.

nodes.name: Withering
nodes.description: Level 40 PassiveAllows Crypt Plague to stack 5 additional times.

nodes.name: Parasite Plague
nodes.description: Damage dealt now has a 5% chance to apply Parasites for 8 seconds.ParasitesYour Undead minions feast upon the parasites on hit, leeching 15% of their damage dealt as Plague Damage to the target.

nodes.name: Fleshcrafting
nodes.description: Increases the duration Unholy Frenzy by 5 sec and casting Command spells now reduces its cooldown by -1 sec.

nodes.name: Apothecary's Cauldron
nodes.description: Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, increases your Magic damage dealt by 3%.

nodes.description: Periodic damage dealt now has a 10% chance to increase your and your Undead minion's haste by 20% for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Fiend
nodes.description: Increases the damage and critical damage of Lichfrost by 20% against diseased targets.

nodes.name: Putricide's Formula
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Undead minions has a 10% chance to blast up to 3 nearby enemies for 71 + 30% SP Plague damage.

nodes.name: Lichplague
nodes.description: Disease an enemy, dealing 151 + 22% SP Plague damage every 3 sec for 18 seconds. Damage increased by 4% for each Necromancer disease on the enemy.

nodes.name: Rot Fetishist

nodes.name: Wormfood

nodes.name: Unholy Erosion

nodes.name: Waking Crypts
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Crypt Plague by 50% and Crypt Swarm now deals 4% more damage for each Necromancer disease you have on the target.

nodes.description: Raise a fallen Gargoyle to aid you in combat, occupying 3 Life Force. Command: Shoots necrotic bile at an enemy, dealing 73 + 65% SP Plague damage, dealing 50% increased damage for each of your diseases on the target.

nodes.name: Muck Summoner
nodes.description: Periodic damage dealt now has an 5% chance to summon 2 to 3 Rotlings that will run towards the enemy and explode after 5 sec for 320 + 33.5% SP Plague damage.

nodes.name: Ice Barrage
nodes.description: Unleash a relentless volley of glacial shards, dealing 19 + 35% SP Frost damage every 0 sec for 1 seconds.At the end of the duration, you entomb your target in ice, freezing them for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Tundra Warriors
nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveCasting any spell now has a 25% chance to grant you Tundra Warriors.Tundra Warriors (Proc)For 10 seconds, the critical strike chance of your Undead minions is increased by 4%, stacking 3 times.

nodes.name: Refreshing Chill
nodes.description: Casting Command spells now has a 20% chance to reset the cooldown of Ice Barrage and make your cast next within 15 seconds free of cost.

nodes.name: Piercing Icicles
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Ice Barrage by 20%.

nodes.name: Frigid Winds
nodes.description: Increases the chance to trigger Refreshing Chill by 5%.

nodes.name: Glacial Impact
nodes.description: Requires Frozen TargetCall down icy boulders onto a Frozen enemy, dealing 84 + 100% frost SP Frost damage.

nodes.name: Ice Mastery
nodes.description: Level 20 PassiveIncreases your spell power by 30% of your Intellect.

nodes.name: Bone Legion
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Lichfrost by 10% and its Runic Power generated by 25%.

nodes.name: Curse of the Lich
nodes.description: Increases the range of your Rime spells by 6 yds and increases the Frost critical strike chance of you and your summons by 3%.

nodes.name: Frigid Death
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Glacial Impact by 20%.

nodes.description: Your Glacial Impact now generates 20 Runic Power.

nodes.name: Heartchill
nodes.description: Chill an enemy's heart, interrupting their current spell cast.Successfully interrupting a spell also reduces their movement speed and haste by -80% for 3 seconds.

nodes.name: Necrotic Chains
nodes.description: Every 3rd Command spell now freezes the target in place for 5 seconds. Damage dealt may end this effect.

nodes.name: Ner'zhul's Blessing
nodes.description: Every 3rd Command spell now makes your next Lichfrost within 10 seconds guaranteed to critically strike.

nodes.name: Giant Bones
nodes.description: Casting Unholy Frenzy now summons a Rotting Frost Giant to aid you in combat for the duration.

nodes.name: Glacier Lord
nodes.description: Your Glacial Impact is now guaranteed to critically strike against Frozen targets.

nodes.name: Icecrown
nodes.description: Your Frost damage dealt now increases your allies' critical strike chance against the enemy by 1% for 10 seconds, stacking 3 times.

nodes.name: Frozen Power
nodes.description: Level 30 PassiveIncreases your critical damage with Frost spells by 50%.

nodes.name: Raise: Skeletal Mage
nodes.description: Raise a Skeletal Mage to aid you in combat, occupying 2 Life Force.Command: Unleashes ice at your target and enemies within 6 yds, dealing 51 + 80% frost SP Frost damage.

nodes.name: Dominion of Frost
nodes.description: Critical strikes dealt by your Undead minions now reduce the cooldown of Unholy Frenzy by -3 sec.

nodes.name: Frigidness
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage by 50% against Frozen targets.

nodes.name: Frigid Power
nodes.description: Increases the spell power scaling of Lichfrost and Ice Barrage by 20%.

nodes.name: Blood and Ice
nodes.description: Each Skeletal Warrior or Skeletal Rogue now increases the damage of your Ice Barrage by 8%.

nodes.name: Death and Ice

nodes.name: Frozen Bodies
nodes.description: When you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor or critically strike with Frost damage you now gain a stack of Frozen Bodies.Frozen BodiesIncreases the damage of your next Glacial Impact by 3% for 20 seconds, stacking 10 times.Reaching 10 stacks causes your next Glacial Impact within until cancelled to critically strike for 50% increased damage.

nodes.name: Permafrost
nodes.description: Gives your spells a 15% chance to grant you the Permafrost, which treats your next 2 spells cast as if the target were Frozen. Lasts 12 seconds.

nodes.name: Deathly Chill
nodes.description: Reduces the channel and cast time of Ice Barrage by -25%.

nodes.name: Lich Form
nodes.description: Transform into a Lich, becoming Undead increasing your Frost damage dealt by 10%.While active you generate 3 Runic Power every 5 sec.

nodes.name: Crown's Call
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 5% and the Frost damage dealt by your Undead minions by 10%.

nodes.name: Chilling Presence
nodes.description: Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. Does not stack with similar effects.In addition, increases the critical strike chance of Ice Barrage by 20% against Frozen targets.

nodes.name: Arch Lich
nodes.description: Critical strikes with Frost spells now refund 3% of your maximum mana.

nodes.name: Raising the Kirin Tor
nodes.description: Your Command spells now have a 40% chance to refund a portion of their Runic Power cost.

nodes.name: Harrowing Winds
nodes.description: Damage dealt by Glacial Impact now deals an additional 50% of the damage dealt as Frost damage to enemies within 6 yds of the primary target.

nodes.name: Soulfreeze
nodes.description: All Frost damage you deal to Frozen targets now has a 25% chance to unleash Soulfreeze on them.SoulfreezeLaunch a chain of frost at an enemy, dealing 354 + 35% frost SP Frost Damage every 1 sec for 3 seconds.Each tick generates 3 to 8 Runic Power.

nodes.name: Champion of Kel'Thuzad

nodes.name: Master Lich
nodes.description: Soulfreeze now increases the enemy's Frost damage taken by you by 5% per tick for 8 sec, stacking 3 times.

nodes.name: Animate: Skeletal Archer

nodes.description: Level 10 PassiveIncreases your maximum Life Force by 1.

nodes.name: Bone King
nodes.description: Casting Command spells now has a 15% chance to make your next Lichfrost or Blight free of cost and instant cast.

nodes.name: Forbidden Technique

Its auto attacks restore 21 + 3.53% Intellect + 3.53% SP health to you.Command: Expels leeching plague that strikes up to 5 nearby enemies, dealing 30 + 15.68% Intellect + 15.68% SP Plague damage, and healing you for 35 + 22% SP + 50% Intellect for each Ghoul.

nodes.name: Animate: Bone Wraith

nodes.name: Ghoul Mastery
nodes.description: Damage dealt by your Ghouls now has a 15% chance to transform them into a Frenzied Ghoul.Frenzied Ghoul (Proc)Transformed into a Frenzied Ghoul, increasing haste by 40% for 10 seconds. Immune to movement slowing effects.

nodes.name: Skeletal Artillery

nodes.name: Putrifier
nodes.description: Increases the durations of Ghoulify and Mass Grave by 25%.

nodes.name: Summoning Expert
nodes.description: Level 30 PassiveIncreases your maximum Life Force by 1 and your Undead minion's Stamina by 10%.

nodes.name: March of the Dead

nodes.name: Mindless Fury
nodes.description: Casting Animate or Command spells now increases your haste by 1% for 10 seconds, stacking 5 times.

nodes.description: Increases the melee haste of your Undead minions by 5% and gives their critical melee auto attacks an 50% chance to trigger Bone Club, dealing 40% of the damage dealt as Shadow Damage.

nodes.name: Crypt Keeper

nodes.name: Unrelenting
nodes.description: Reduces the channel time of your Crypt Swarm by -25%.

nodes.name: Unstoppable Frenzy
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Unholy Frenzy by -60 sec.

nodes.name: Army of the Dead
nodes.description: While only 1 Abomination is active, the critical strike chance of your Ghouls is increased by 10% and haste by 10%.

nodes.name: Lich's Prodigy
nodes.description: Your Glacial Tap now generates an additional 20 Runic Power, but its cost is increased by 25%.

nodes.name: Diabolical
nodes.description: Level 40 PassiveCasting spells now grants you 1 stack of Diabolical, stacking up to 15 times, for 20 seconds.Damage dealt by your Crypt Swarm will consume a stack to deal 10% increased damage per stack.
